title: Synthetic Orders API teaching contract
identityWarning: X-Customer-Id is a caller-controlled synthetic customer scope, NOT authentication or authorization.

quantity.description: JSON integer token only; numeric strings are rejected.

responses.201: First successful creation; order response and Location header.
responses.200: Same customer, key, sku and quantity: return the original complete order.
responses.400: Invalid request body or required headers.
responses.409: Same customer and key but changed sku or quantity; ProblemDetails with code=idempotency_conflict.
responses.415: Request does not have a JSON content type.

responses.200: JSON array containing only this synthetic customer's orders, including [] when empty.
Order belonging to this synthetic customer.
responses.400: Missing or invalid X-Customer-Id, or a non-GUID id.
responses.404: Order does not exist in this synthetic customer's scope.

responses.200: Service is healthy; no customer or idempotency header required.

requestLimits.identifierPolicy: SKU and both headers start with an ASCII letter or digit; remaining characters are ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.

idempotency.comparison: Compare parsed sku and quantity exactly; SKU comparison is case-sensitive. JSON formatting whitespace and property order do not affect equality.
idempotency.concurrentSameRequests: Exactly one creation (201); all other successful requests replay (200) the same id.
idempotency.restart: A process restart using the same data store must preserve replay identity and payload-conflict detection.
idempotency.differentCustomers: The same key is independent for each synthetic customer.
idempotency.validation: Validate before writing; rejected input must not consume the key.
idempotency.retention: No automatic expiry is specified in this local teaching lab.

modes.fixed: Reference implementation satisfies the acceptance matrix.
modes.duplicate: Intentional failure: replay creates another order.
modes.memory: Intentional failure: idempotency state does not survive process restart.
modes.payload: Intentional failure: same key replays without comparing sku/quantity.
